glyph_rationales.a refusal: M19: a judgment's edge — a refusal needs an edge; a perception needs a difference
glyph_rationales.needs an edge: M19: the cut that lets anything appear or be asked
glyph_rationales.a world: M19: without difference no world becomes articulate — difference cannot be escaped (gilded: the stakes)
glyph_rationales.−/−: M20: the bare relation — a stroke between two unassigned marks, before a determinate contrast is given
glyph_rationales.(−1)/(+1): M20: dia's polar form — positive and negative held through a common zero; the stroke retains polarity rather than instructing division
glyph_rationales.(−1)+(+1)=0: M20: the collapsed operation — addition cancels to 0; changing the operation changes the result (the step reddens: the appropriation the record marks)
glyph_rationales.0/1: M21: one orientation of the retained ground–mark relation (earned notation, §1); in m24 the pair B={0,1} counted with its pairings
glyph_rationales.(0/1)/(1/0): M21: sym-ballein — superpositional polarity as inverse orientations of one relation; recognition through the maintained break (gilded when held)
glyph_rationales.1/0: M21: the other orientation, held at attract — the two lean toward one another without fusing
glyph_rationales.the net: M22: Hephaestus's bonds too fine to see — craft that encloses relation (planted here per the presaging ledger; paid off at §5→0 · #3)
glyph_rationales.Harmonia: M22: concord borne through the conjunction of beauty and strife — opposition generative without silencing (the triangle appears between the drawn-together pair)
glyph_rationales.bifurcate: M23: dia as dynamical operation — bifurcate a field, make a trajectory actual
glyph_rationales.compose: M23: sym as dynamical operation — recursively compose differentiated trajectories into a provisional basin (the ring: trajectories drawn, boundaries open)
glyph_rationales.perturbation: M23: perturbation opens the basin to further difference (the step reddens and tips: the opening)
glyph_rationales.4+2: M24: the first compact QL theorem — 2 + 2² = 6 = 4 + 2: what a two amounts to once it includes the relation that generates it
glyph_rationales.B={0,1}: M24: the minimum recursive body counted directly — pair each with each, retaining order
glyph_rationales.2+2²: M24: the generative count on the way to 6 — two poles plus the four ordered pairings
